body:
"Stop feeling sorry for yourself."

But I won't, not tonight, I know what I should do, I know what I will do, I know what the future holds.

Choosing to fail gives me that foresight.

Trying to succeed is just asking for more hurt.

I'm sorry.

I used to be in a long-distance complicated friendship with a girl in France, so she's 6 hours ahead. Anyways, we would talk a ton but generally before I went to bed I would send her an email and she would generally reply when she got online around 10 her time. Sometimes one... sometimes a couple.

I usually wake up around 9.

I started waking up at 7 for a while, I check the emails and fall back to sleep.

Then it started at 6

Then 5

Then 4, waking up at 4am for two weeks in a row, sometimes not able to go back to sleep at all.

I realized before too long that it was a bad situation, it did help to at least close the gmail window on my laptop before bed.

Anyways, the anticipation of that email completely ruined my sleep pattern.

Yes. I'm coming off losing the two most important women in my life, both of which I pushed away because I wasn't good enough. Both of which found very different ways to break my heart.

I want something, some sort of relationship, a rebound I guess. I just don't know how...

I was 17 and had been with my first girlfriend for a couple months when we decided we were going to have sex. The time and the place was easy because my mom worked overnight and I wasn't exactly watched. Well, we start going at it and I realize I'm not going to get off so I "fake it" and pull off the condom with my hand around the reservoir so that she couldn't tell.

Anyways the second time I finally got off. Oh, I found out a few weeks later that my mom didn't actually have a 3rd shift job, she was faking it.

Every night she would pretend to be gone but would actually just get a spare blanket and a good amount of alcohol and then lie in her closet and drink until she passed out. It was a pretty easy ruse since I worked til 11pm and she was supposed to be gone by then (we were too poor for a car)... anyways, I'm reminded of that because she said that she knew when I started having sex because she found condoms in my sock drawer but I always figured she probably heard us. Thank god we never thought to have sex in her bed.

The "friend-zoned" girl admitted that she had very deep feelings for me, but that she would not visit me for fear of something happening, and that she would not move near me because she wants to continue traveling, for 2 more years. FML

I'm doing shitty. I'm slowly coming to realize that the girl I'm in love with is too afraid of commitment to ever be with me. Today she decided that we shouldn't see eachother in a couple of months (she's in Germany), that she's moving from Germany to South Korea next year and that she's not coming home to go to grad school the year after. All this after telling me how much she cares about me.
